text: The leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neuron models the cell membrane as what?
choices: A lossless inductor that stores the spike energy
A leaky capacitor charged by the input current, with tau_m*dV/dt = -(V - V_rest) + R*I(t)
A nonlinear oscillator that always fires periodically
explanation: LIF treats the membrane as a leaky RC capacitor that integrates input current toward V_infinity with a leak e^{-t/tau_m} and fires when V reaches V_th. It has memory (the integration), is not an inductor, does not oscillate autonomously, and keeps sub-threshold dynamics rather than being a memoryless comparator.
